issuer: the Finnish Transport and Communications Agency (Traficom), through Ajovarma
note: The Driving Licence Act (ajokorttilaki 386/2011), the consolidated text on Finlex (rendered in a browser because its text loads by script; read 2026-10-30): § 5 sets the minimum age for classes B and BE at 18 (17 only for students in professional driver training, not held; a 17-year-old's B entitlement, newly in § 5 a, doesn't hold between midnight and 5 am); § 22 issues a group 1 licence for 15 years at a time (to 70, then five years). The fee is set by the Ministry's decree on Traficom's chargeable services and charged through Ajovarma, neither read (Traficom's guessed pages answered 404, Ajovarma's price list redirected to a sign-up page), so it is null. The identity card is the Police's and isn't held; no exchange list is held.

sources.said: B- ja BE-luokassa 18 vuotta; ... Ryhmään 1 kuuluva ajokortti annetaan 15 vuodeksi kerrallaan ja kuitenkin enintään määräajaksi, joka päättyy hakijan täyttäessä 70 vuotta.
